name: Shrouded Stars keeps paying Magic Stagger every second while magic hits keep arriving
contract: Shrouded Stars 704785: "you delay $s3% of direct magical damage taken, instead taking it over $954791d".
Magic Stagger 954791 lasts 10 s with a 1 s period, so it has 10 ticks. DelayDamage refreshed it with
Aura::SetDuration, which leaves the aura effect's tick counter alone: after 10 ticks since the first hit it
never ticked again while later hits kept refreshing the duration, the delayed damage piled up unpaid, and
it was all dealt in one hit when the aura finally ended. Aura::RefreshDuration resets the counter.
Expected: with a direct magic hit every 2.5 s for 15 s, Magic Stagger still ticks about once a second
(more than the 10 ticks one application can hold), and the Starcaller is alive at the end.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Enough health that the test cannot end by death
